highlights_headline: The unreleased 4.158.0 changes correct mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads return different glyph data.

bullets.detail: When consecutive font-scaler loads disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded glyph and clears incompatible masks instead of copying them. This avoids stale outlines, format assertions, and sub-byte buffer overwrites; clipped embossed glyphs also retain correct data across all three mask planes.
